title: Payload of `keyset`
description: gateway → node: a new core or gateway public key, announced in an `authz` (kind `keyset`) signed by the current core key. The node accepts it only if `authz.object.args` names the same role, key_id and public_key, and `authz.object.target_node_id` is null or the node itself (R12-27). `outbox_id` is the unsigned ID of the `keys.keyset` outbox item; the node acks it only after accepting the keyset (R12-26).

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.
